source.text: በህየ፡ ርእየ፡ አዕይንትየ፡ ቆላ፡ *ርኁወ፡ ወዕሙቀ፡ አፉሁ፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ የኀድሩ፡ ዲበ፡ የብስ፡ ወባሕር፡ ወደሴት፡ አምኀ፡ ወአስተያ፡ ወጋዳ፡ የመጽኡ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዕሙቅ፡ ቆላ፡ ኢይመልእ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 main-text body/native photographs collated. Selected stars, dagger and editorial brackets retained; raised apparatus numerals excluded; punctuation spacing normalized. Author proposal, not fresh manuscript certification. No later English oracle used.

translation.text: There my eyes saw a valley whose mouth was open and deep. All who dwell on dry land, the sea and the islands bring gifts, drink offerings and offerings, yet the whole deep valley will not be filled.

footnotes.text: The selected አስተያ belongs to drinking vocabulary (bibere/potio/potus) in actual primary Dillmann365–366. Drink offerings is a contextual rendering within this gift/offerings list, not an assertion that the lexicon establishes a particular libation ritual; generic presents obscures the drinking sense. The source piles up dwellers, gifts/drink offerings/offerings and people bringing them. English joins the clauses without adding a destination or naming recipients. The final not-be-filled negative and dry land, sea and islands are retained.
